about: FR-G7's module registry, the half code reads (Story 4.7). research-section-js-libraries.md §2.1 is the list and §7 keeps each module's no-JS line and edit-safe sentence; `python3 tools/derive-module-reach.py --check` fails when this file and that prose disagree. `core` is the platform runtime and is never a row: it runs on every page and no design declares it. `animates` sends a module through core's one reduced-motion gate, true only where §3.1's reduced-motion line is §7's no-JS state. `retired` names a module that must not come back, with the ruling that retired it. `strings` (Story 4.9) lists the catalog's js keys a module writes; both emitters stamp each as data-i18n-* on the module's mount (S5), and only a row appendix-h1 §3 names the module for carries one.

retired.search-overlay: retired by ruling R-24: search is Ghost's native sodo-search, which a plain element carrying data-ghost-search opens with no module
retired.search-expand: retired on 2026-08-27: no design claims it, and search is Ghost's native sodo-search (R-24)
retired.command-palette: retired by ruling R-24: its only consumer was A23, which is deleted, and no Inflozo design may bind ⌘K, which sodo-search already takes
retired.confetti: retired by the owner's ruling of 2026-08-31: no design in the library declares it
retired.sort: never built, by ruling R-52: a gallery shows the order its owner arranged, and filter-strip filters by linking to Ghost's own routes
